question: Should OpenClaw accept `referenceContext` as the public plugin SDK lane and Codex `turn/start.additionalContext` as the first supported host transport, while embedded and generic hosts reject engines that require the lane?
rationale: This is a public plugin API and prompt-authority/security boundary decision; code review can verify the implementation path, but cannot choose the permanent SDK semantics or security model for maintainers.

options.title: Approve After Conflict Refresh
options.body: Maintainers accept the SDK field, host capability, Codex untrusted additionalContext projection, and 0.142.4 lane gate once the branch is rebased and green.

options.title: Narrow The Public Surface
options.body: Revise or hide the exported renderer/type/capability shape before merge if maintainers want a smaller or different permanent plugin contract.

options.title: Pause Behind The Design Issue
options.body: Keep this PR open but unmerged while the linked issue remains the product/security design owner for cross-provider authority semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve After Conflict Refresh
recommendation.body: Maintainers accept the SDK field, host capability, Codex untrusted additionalContext projection, and 0.142.4 lane gate once the branch is rebased and green.
